channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: India raises a toast to premium pours, snubs budget liquor
item.description: Radico Khaitan and United Breweries report strong premium portfolio growth, while United Spirits flags pressure on lower-income consumers and rising costs

item.title: Students using Google search in classroom accounts will need access to AI tools, the company says
item.description: Students using Google search in classroom accounts will need access to AI tools, the company says

item.title: US lawmakers, in letter, question McDonald’s CEO about algorithmic pricing practices
item.description: MCDONALDS/LAWMAKERS-LETTER (EXCLUSIVE):US lawmakers, in letter, question McDonald’s CEO about algorithmic pricing practices

item.title: Firm Tied to Some OpenAI, Anthropic AI Hacks Blames ‘Error’
item.description: A spate of cyberattacks involving AI agents from some of the world’s top model makers were down to a human error and time pressures at Israeli security company Irregular Security, according to Chief Executive Officer Dan Lahav.

item.title: Apple's record India quarter has more to it than meets the eyes
item.description: Apple hit record quarterly revenue in India by pushing device prices above $1,000, but iPhone sales volumes dropped up to 25% as steep price hikes deterred first-time buyers.&nbsp;

item.title: AdaniConneX in talks with global banks for $1.5 billion loan: What will the funds finance?
item.description: AdaniConneX is reportedly seeking about $1.5 billion in offshore financing for data centres, as Adani and Reliance ramp up investment in AI and digital infrastructure. The expansion reflects India’s growing demand for computing capacity.

item.title: NTT DATA to nearly triple Mangaluru workforce to 2,500 by 2027; expansion to focus on AI, cloud
item.description: The proposed expansion is expected to strengthen Mangaluru's position as an emerging technology destination under Karnataka's broader strategy to attract investments and create employment opportunities beyond Bengaluru.

item.title: Air India ceases ops on several routes; flights to Vienna, Copenhagen, Chicago halted, report says: Here's why
item.description: Air India has suspended flights to several destinations in Europe and the United States, including Vienna, Copenhagen, Chicago, Newark, London Gatwick and Birmingham. The airline has also shifted some domestic routes to Air India Express.

item.title: IndiGo to get first Airbus A350 in 2028: CEO Willie Walsh outlines 600-plane fleet goal and expansion plan
item.description: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh said IndiGo had established the necessary foundations to succeed in the long-haul market. The planned introduction of Airbus A350 aircraft forms part of the airline's broader international expansion strategy.

item.title: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu joins RSS route march in Tamil Nadu: Why the tech billionaire is back in spotlight
item.description: Zoho founder Sridhar Vembu participated in an RSS route march in Tamil Nadu's Tenkasi district on November 1, drawing attention to his earlier remarks about being influenced by a Marxist teacher as a teenager. The procession was part of the RSS's centenary-year celebrations.

item.title: Air India weighs Mumbai shift for Europe, US flights as airspace curbs bite
item.description: The airline plans to expand its Asian network through Delhi and explore Bengaluru as a third hub as mounting losses sharpen its focus on costs.

item.title: Yes Bank bondholders step up pressure for restoration of ₹8,415 crore AT1 bonds
item.description: The association has sought a time-bound restoration plan and clarity on unpaid coupons, while questioning the bank's role in selling the bonds to individual investors.

item.title: Why does IndiGo want lower charges at Mumbai airport? CEO Willie Walsh weighs in on airport investments
item.description: IndiGo CEO Willie Walsh says Mumbai airport’s per-passenger charges should fall after Terminal 1’s redevelopment increases capacity. He argues airport costs affect fares and airlines’ ability to earn returns, and calls for closer scrutiny of airport investments and their impact across the industry.

item.title: Chandrasekaran allays fears of Iveco plant closures ahead of union talks
item.description: Tata Sons chairman assures Italian unions and regulators that the €3.9 billion buyout will not lead to plant closures, as both automakers move to unlock technology and regional market synergies.

item.title: Who is Dan Driscoll? OpenAI hires ex-US Army Secretary and Trump's 'drone guy' to lead national security AI push
item.description: OpenAI has appointed former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as its senior counsellor for national security modernisation. He will advise the company and its partners on deploying AI in defence, cybersecurity and military operations.

item.title: Tata Trusts vs Tata Sons: FM Sitharaman urges ‘maturity' from leadership; why did she refuse to interfere in dispute?
item.description: FM Sitharaman urged Tata Trusts and Tata Sons to resolve their dispute amicably through dialogue, saying the group’s importance to India makes the matter significant. She called for maturity and a swift return to normalcy, while declining to say whether the government would intervene.

item.title: Wipro Consumer H1 revenue jumps 17% to ₹6,094 crore; eyes ₹20,000 crore by FY30
item.description: A 14.9% revenue increase in India and strong demand in Vietnam and the Philippines drive robust first-half growth for the FMCG firm.

item.title: Jewellery startup Giva raises $100 mn in funding round led by Multiples PE, others
item.description: This investment will enable Giva to strengthen its leadership team, build manufacturing capabilities and expand its offline presence.

item.title: Who is Saurabh Chandrakar? From working at a juice shop to becoming the alleged mastermind of Mahadev betting app
item.description: Chandrakar was brought back to India on Sunday following his extradition from Oman. On Monday (November 2), the Delhi-based Rouse Avenue Court granted the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) a two-day transit remand to take him to Raipur, where criminal proceedings against him are pending.

item.title: Microsoft India salary hikes: 91% get 5% or less as tech giant rolls out voluntary buyout
item.description: 86% of Microsoft respondents, the survey said, expressed dissatisfaction with their increments, making the tech giant one of the lowest-rated employers, second only to Zoho.

item.title: Pee Safe eyes ₹250 cr revenue in FY27 ahead of planned IPO: Co-founder Rithish Kumar in exclusive interview | Top points
item.description: Pee Safe is focusing on sub-brands, scaling revenue, expanding retail distribution and market expansion ahead of its ambitious IPO planned for FY29-30, co-founder Rithish Kumar tells Livemint.

item.title: Murikenchery tipped to lead Navi Mumbai airport as Adani braces for Mumbai traffic shift
item.description: If confirmed, Murikenchery would face one of the most difficult operational challenges in Indian aviation as Adani prepares to move 265 of the 770 weekly international departure slots from Terminal 2 of Mumbai airport to Navi Mumbai.

item.title: Marico's Saffola ready to shed low-margin volumes
item.description: Marico Ltd is shifting away from low-margin products for premium offerings such as cold-pressed oils, betting on a reset in profitability over the next few quarters.

item.title: SBI posts quarterly profit rise on loan growth, stake sale
item.description: The country's largest lender by assets reported a net profit of 23,038 crore rupees ($2.43 billion) for the quarter ended September 30, up from 20,160 crore rupees a year earlier.

item.title: Who is Tejesh Vaish? IIT Kanpur grad's journey from making samosas, jalebis to AI industry shows hard work pays off
item.description: Tejesh Vaish’s journey from helping his father make samosas and jalebis at a modest sweet shop in Lucknow to building a career in artificial intelligence in Dubai is an inspiring story of perseverance.

item.title: Who is Pankaj Pandey? Power Grid's new Director (Operations) to succeed Naveen Srivastava in December
item.description: Pankaj Pandey’s appointment will take effect from the date he assumes charge of the post, which will be on or after 1 December 2026.

item.title: When Reliance, Thala Ajith joined hands! Mukesh Ambani's FMCG segment expands Independence biscuit portfolio; 9 variants
item.description: Reliance Consumer Products is expanding its Independence biscuit range with nine variants and 28 new SKUs, launching first across Tamil Nadu. Prices range from ₹5 to ₹125, with distribution through retail and online channels.&nbsp;

item.title: Microsoft plans $25 billion through bond sale, interest rates go up to 6.35%: What to know
item.description: These bonds have maturities ranging from 2028 to 2066. Microsoft is issuing 10 tranches of bonds with different interest and maturity dates. Of this $25 billion, the company plans to raise $6 billion through the floating-rate bonds and $19 billion through fixed-rate bonds.

item.title: Who is Sanjay D'Souza? Meet HDFC Bank executive who retired after 27 years with the private lender
item.description: HDFC Bank executive Sanjay D’Souza retired effective 31 October after nearly 27 years at the lender. As Group Head of Business Banking and Emerging &amp; Micro Enterprises, he helped build its SME business.&nbsp;

item.title: Nandini curd price revision in Karnataka: KMF agrees to ₹2 per litre cut after 1 November hike; check old vs new prices
item.description: Karnataka CM D K Shivakumar says KMF has agreed to his suggestion to cut Nandini curd prices by ₹2 per litre, days after the 1 November hike. Here's a look at the old prices, revised rates, and proposed prices after the reduction.

item.title: Who is Ramkripa Ananthan? Meet the pioneering woman designer behind Mahindra Thar and XUV700 designs
item.description: Ramkripa Ananthan helped shape Mahindra’s distinctive SUV designs, including the Thar, XUV700 and Scorpio. A BITS Pilani and IIT Bombay graduate, she joined Mahindra in 1997 and later led its design team. After founding Krux Studio in 2021, she became Ola Electric’s Head of Design in 2022.

item.title: Richest person in Asia: Mukesh Ambani vs Zhang Yiming net worth — Reliance boss overtakes China's ByteDance TikTok head
item.description: The bullish momentum in Reliance stock also rides on the coattails of a blockbuster market debut by its digital and telecommunications arm, Jio Platforms.

item.title: Adani Group said to seek $1.5 billion for data centre financing
item.description: Adani's data centre unit, AdaniConneX, is in talks with lenders including DBS Group, First Abu Dhabi Bank PJSC and Mitsubishi UFJ for the offshore facility.

item.title: Investcorp eyes exit from Kitchen Treasures at up to ₹1,000 crore valuation
item.description: Investcorp is exploring a sale of its stake in Kitchen Treasures’ parent at a valuation of ₹800-1,000 crore, as investor interest in India’s packaged food market gathers pace.

item.title: Disney layoffs: Thousands of job cuts expected as company targets 20% cost savings; these operations to be hit hardest
item.description: The cuts will disproportionately impact specific operations across Disney's sprawling empire, which includes its theme parks, television networks, and movie studios, Bloomberg said.
